This infrastructure is used to measure AWS service performance, conducting comprehensive analyses that drive critical business decisions at the CEO/SVP level and help guide teams in delivering the best cloud services in the industry. The primary deliverables are the infrastructure and automation required to accelerate, simplify, and make efficient deep-dive performance dashboards that identify recommendations to influence product direction across multiple AWS services.
  
  
This role requires exceptional software development skills and a passion for distributed system performance and statistics. Experience or strong interest in building agentic AI systems, including autonomous troubleshooting agents, LLM-driven infrastructure provisioning, and intelligent automation for operational workflows would be ideal. The candidate will excel at simplifying complex systems for use across multiple stakeholders with diverse backgrounds. The ideal candidate has knowledge of containers, AWS services, and building Python libraries. This role will build tools to investigate performance bottlenecks while maintaining the highest standards of technical rigor and objectivity.

* Design and implement software solutions that address customer needs, balancing scalability, maintainability, performance, and security requirements across major portions of your team's systems.

* Evaluate and integrate generative AI tools and AWS services where appropriate to improve productivity, solution quality, and the overall customer experience.

There are few existing internal tools that exist today, so you will have the independence to chose different technical stacks. Your great system design and implementation skills will be exercised on a daily basis. You should also be comfortable collaborating regularly with a diverse team of varying technical capabilities and build solutions to measure the performance of a range of AWS services from EC2 to Trainium2, Sagemaker studio, and AI agents. We are excited about what lies ahead and are looking for engineers who want to help us build reliable, innovative solutions that will define how we serve customers for years to come.

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

### Job Summary

Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon.

Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place.

The Emergency Preparedness & Response (EP&R) team builds the systems that keep critical operations running when it matters most. When storms and severe weather threaten communities and infrastructure across the US, our platform enables customers to rapidly procure, mobilize, and manage the workforce needed to respond to and recover from storm damage - often under tight timelines and high-stakes conditions. We are looking for a Principal Engineer who is deeply hands-on, works backward from customer pain points and business needs, and measures success by impact rather than lines of code shipped. You will be the technical anchor of the team: a backend-heavy full-stack engineer who knows our systems inside and out, reasons rigorously about trade-offs, and raises the engineering bar for everyone around you while leading the team toward outcomes that genuinely matter.

### Role Overview

Were hiring a Software Engineer in Bengaluru to build and run production services. Youll own features end to end - from understanding the problem to shipping, monitoring and fixing what you built - with growing independence and support from senior engineers.

Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. Youll work closely with senior engineers, your Engineering Manager, Product and Customer Support.

### What youll own in your first year

* **Own:** Own features and services end to end with speed and quality - build, test, release, monitor, fix.
* **Well-scoped problems, then bigger ones.** Start with clearly defined work and grow into breaking down ambiguous problems yourself.
* **Design.** Write design notes for your features and get them reviewed; contribute to larger designs led by senior engineers.
* **Quality.** Write tests, add observability, and take part in on-call so issues are caught before customers see them.
* **Customers.** Understand who uses what you build, and learn from support issues what to fix next.
* **Code reviews.** Give and receive thoughtful reviews, and help onboard engineers who join after you.

### What you must bring

These are the bar. We cant teach them on the job.

* **Experience:** 1-4 years building production software. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone.
* **Youve shipped code that runs in production.** Features or services you built, released and supported - not only coursework or prototypes.
* **You are strong at problem solving.** You can take an unfamiliar, feature-sized problem, reason through it, and land on a simple, correct solution.
* **You work independently toward a clear goal.** Given a clear goal, you figure out the steps, unblock yourself, and ask for help at the right moments.

We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in.

### Technical background

Youve built production software with a modern stack, such as:

* **Cloud:** hands-on with AWS - youve deployed and debugged services running on it.
* **Languages:** strong in at least one modern language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* **Frameworks:** modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents.
* **Databases:** solid data modeling and query fundamentals - you can design a schema, use indexes well, and explain why a query is slow and how youd fix it.
* **Fundamentals:** data structures, API design, and the basics of caching and concurrency.

Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome.

### What sets great candidates apart

* **Impact you can explain.** You can say what changed because of something you built - for users, performance or reliability.
* **One problem you went deep on.** A bug, a performance issue or a design where you dug past the surface to understand why.
* **Ownership beyond the ticket.** Youve fixed what you shipped when it broke, and improved it after release without being asked.
* **Framework mindset:** You notice repeated code and turn it into something reusable.
* **Learning speed.** Youve picked up a new domain, codebase or technology quickly and delivered in it.
* **Curiosity about the user.** Youve asked why a requirement exists, or suggested a simpler way to solve the users problem.

### What we look for in everyone we hire

Whatever the role, we hire for six things.

* **Customer obsession.** You care who uses what you build and whether it actually helped them.

### Job Summary

Zettle India, part of PayPals Payment Services and Crypto organization, is hiring a Software Engineer in Test (SDET). Our POS platform moves real money for merchants every day across mobile apps, cloud services, and card readers. In this hands-on role, youll turn designs into written risk models before code exists, build automated checks that gate real merges, and encode how the payments domain behaves so the knowledge outlives any one person. Youll help shape how test engineering works on a platform where quality is built in, not bolted on. If youd rather build the thing than maintain it, read on - the best is yet to come!

### Essential Responsibilities

* Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff
* Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures
* Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions
* Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions
* May contribute to code & design reviews

### Minimum Qualifications

* 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

### What you need to know about the role

PayPal POS sits at the heart of how many SMBs run their businesses every day. Card payments, card readers and hardware variance, acquiring, payments SDKs, ledger and financial flows, onboarding and checkout across web and mobile. As a Test Engineer here, you wont hand down verdicts after the fact; youll build the capability that lets verification happen without you in the room. The engineering discipline bar is the same as any software role: version control, review in both directions, CI, design before implementation, and root-cause debugging by the owner. The Test Engineer will be integral part of the team and takes pride in advocating for the quality of the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS, along with the backend and web services behind it.

### Meet our team

Zettle is PayPals point-of-sale and payments product for small businesses. Zettle India is part of the Payment Services and Crypto organization, and our test engineering team supports the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS and the services behind it. We are a centralized Test and Quality Engineering function actively moving to an automation-first, shift-left culture. You will be joining a growing team and help shape its test strategy, automation framework, and quality standards. You will partner closely with developers and product managers, and mentor engineers in the team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, with three days a week onsite.

### Your way to impact

As a Test Engineer, you will help make sure that merchants can take payments without problems on any device. You will own testing for the features you work on, from test planning to release, and you will help move our testing from manual to automated over time. Your work will reduce production defects, speed up releases, and improve the experience of small businesses that use Zettle every day. You will grow toward a Senior Test Engineer role as you build your technical depth and ownership.

### In your day-to-day role you will be responsible for

* Understand requirements and design test cases, test scenarios, and end-to-end tests for Zettle mobile app features on Android and iOS.
* Write and merge automated cross-service / interop tests into CI/CD pipelines that gate real merges; debug every failure to root cause.
* Perform manual and exploratory testing on real devices, emulators, and simulators across OS versions, screen sizes, and network conditions.
* Test APIs and backend services using Postman or RestAssured and validate data using SQL queries.
* Run tests on BrowserStack and in CI/CD pipelines (Harness) and analyze failures to find the root cause.
* Log clear, reproducible defects in JIRA with logs (Logcat, Xcode), screenshots, and screen recordings, and follow them through to closure.
* Maintain test cases and test runs in TestRail, and report test status and risks to the team. Reduce flaky tests and suggest ideas to improve test coverage, speed, and quality.

* Implement multi-sensor fusion pipelines combining Electro-Optical (EO), Infrared (IR), and Inertial Navigation System (INS) data using Kalman / Extended Kalman Filters (EKF) and Particle Filters.

* Experience: 1+ years of hands-on experience in object detection, recognition, and tracking using deep-learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent).
* Domain Experience: Demonstrated work on aerial/UAV imagery or thermal/IR datasets (handling scale variation, motion blur, and low contrast).
